title: GridLens catalogue record
description: One JSON object per line in data/raw/catalogue.jsonl. See data/DATA_SCHEMA.md for the full field-by-field rationale -- this file is the machine-checkable contract scripts/validate_dataset.py enforces.

id.description: Unique, stable identifier. Never renumber/reuse an existing id -- other rows' `notes` may cross-reference it by exact string (e.g. "see ORG-AFME-0010").

institution_category.description: Empty string means not yet classified -- validate_dataset.py warns (not errors) on this, since older migrated rows may not have it yet. Fill it in for every new entry.

country_label.description: Canonical country name. Check data/DATA_SCHEMA.md's alias list before using an unfamiliar spelling.

tool_explicitly_named.description: Does the source explicitly name this tool (vs. a generic "energy system model")?

use_case.description: What the tool is actually used for. Be as specific as the evidence allows -- this is what Grid Decisions classification reads.

decision_type.description: Leave blank if you don't have specific evidence of the decision purpose -- scripts/sync_dataset.py will infer one from institution_category and mark decision_basis='inferred' automatically. Fill it in directly (with real evidence in use_case/exact_snippet_or_quote) when you do, and the sync script will respect it as decision_basis='documented'.

decision_basis.description: Leave blank -- scripts/sync_dataset.py sets this automatically based on whether decision_type was filled in directly (documented) or inferred by the script (inferred). Don't hand-set this to 'documented' unless decision_type is backed by real evidence.

exact_snippet_or_quote.description: A direct quote, strongly preferred over paraphrase. See data/DATA_SCHEMA.md's evidence standards.

status.description: Only status=confirmed rows sync into the app.

batch_id.description: Free-text provenance tag for which research pass/session found this row, e.g. 'weekly_llm_scan_2027w03'. Shown to end users as the record's dataset origin.
